description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Healer of the Glade, adding {G}.
Healer of the Glade dies, triggering Titania's second ability, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Healer of the Glade from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Healer of the Glade enters the battlefield, causing you to gain three life.
Repeat.
